notes: Non-medication care instructions: home safety, food and fluid rules, eye drops, bowels, and the labs needed before the next visit.

cases.title: Fall prevention: rails, footwear, lighting, physio booking
lines: Doctor: She fell twice in the bathroom, but the scans and the heart are not the problem.
Nurse: Please arrange rails on both sides of the corridor and inside the toilet.
Doctor: Wear the non-slip shoes indoors, slippers are what sent her down.
Nurse: Please keep the hallway light on at night so she can see the floor.
Doctor: No stairs without someone nearby, and do not climb the terrace to fetch things.
Nurse: Make sure the walking frame is beside the bed before she stands up.
Doctor: Keep the call bell within her reach, and please note the room she fell in.
Nurse: Shift the family duty so someone is awake with her between midnight and four.
Doctor: Book the follow-up physio session every Monday and Thursday for the leg strength.

items.quote: Please arrange rails on both sides of the corridor and inside the toilet.
Wear the non-slip shoes indoors, slippers are what sent her down.
Please keep the hallway light on at night so she can see the floor.
No stairs without someone nearby, and do not climb the terrace to fetch things.
Make sure the walking frame is beside the bed before she stands up.
Keep the call bell within her reach, and please note the room she fell in.
Shift the family duty so someone is awake with her between midnight and four.
items.note: 'between midnight and four' is outside the schedule grammar, no clock reading is claimed

items.quote: Book the follow-up physio session every Monday and Thursday for the leg strength.
items.note: extract_schedule returns only the first match, so Thursday is dropped

cases.title: Chronic kidney diet: fluid cap, salt, protein, potassium, walking
lines: Doctor: Her kidneys are tired, so the food rules matter more than any tablet this month.
Nurse: Boil and cool the water, and keep the total fluid to one litre a day.
Doctor: Do not add salt at the table, and skip the pickle and the papad.
Nurse: One egg and half a cup of dal every morning for protein.
Doctor: Do not eat banana or coconut water, the potassium climbs after them.
Nurse: A thirty minute walk after dinner, five days a week, and stop at the first chest pain.
Doctor: Please get the haemoglobin and the potassium done before the next visit.
Nurse: Make sure to call us the same day if she cannot drink at all or starts vomiting.

items.quote: Boil and cool the water, and keep the total fluid to one litre a day.
items.note: 'one litre a day' is not read: the extractor needs a numeral before 'a day'

items.quote: Do not add salt at the table, and skip the pickle and the papad.
One egg and half a cup of dal every morning for protein.
Do not eat banana or coconut water, the potassium climbs after them.
items.note: a food the family must not give reads as diet, not avoid: 'banana' is not in the avoid hint list

items.quote: A thirty minute walk after dinner, five days a week, and stop at the first chest pain.
items.note: the 'five days a week' part of the dose of exercise is not read

items.quote: Please get the haemoglobin and the potassium done before the next visit.
items.note: 'before the next visit' is a deadline, not a slot: nothing is read

items.quote: Make sure to call us the same day if she cannot drink at all or starts vomiting.

cases.title: Cataract follow-up: drop technique, second eye date, red-eye warning
lines: Doctor: The cataract operation went well, the vision is better already.
Nurse: Instill the antibiotic drops in the right eye, four times a day for the next ten days.
Doctor: Use the steroid drops five times a day for one week, then halve it.
Nurse: Make sure to wash the hands before opening the drop bottle.
Doctor: Do not let the drops touch the eyelashes, keep the tip away from the eye.
Doctor: Wear the dark glasses outdoors, the light will hurt for a week.
Doctor: She must come back on 25/11 for the second eye, please arrange the transport.
Doctor: No rubbing the eye, and no dust near it for ten days.
Nurse: Make sure to call us the same day if the eye goes red, painful or the vision drops.

items.quote: Instill the antibiotic drops in the right eye, four times a day for the next ten days.
Use the steroid drops five times a day for one week, then halve it.
items.note: 'five times a day' is matched by the extractor but parse_schedule counts only up to four

items.quote: Make sure to wash the hands before opening the drop bottle.
Do not let the drops touch the eyelashes, keep the tip away from the eye.
Wear the dark glasses outdoors, the light will hurt for a week.
items.note: a duration ('for a week') is not a schedule the grammar can read

items.quote: She must come back on 25/11 for the second eye, please arrange the transport.
No rubbing the eye, and no dust near it for ten days.
items.note: a bare 'No <thing>' with no drug word is not in the avoid rules, so this warning is lost

items.quote: Make sure to call us the same day if the eye goes red, painful or the vision drops.

cases.title: Constipation after iron: syrup titration, fluids and fibre, charting
lines: Doctor: The constipation came back after the iron, so today we soften the motion.
Nurse: Use the lactulose syrup 15 ml at bedtime, and adjust it to two soft motions a day.
Doctor: Take one tablet of the stool softener at night for two weeks.
Nurse: Warm water and more fibre, and a walk after each meal, will do more than any pill.
Doctor: Do not take the senna or the bisacodyl tablet daily, the bowel gets dependent.
Nurse: Please note how many motions happen each day, and bring that note to the clinic.
Doctor: If there is blood in the motion or no motion for three days, make sure to call us.

items.quote: Use the lactulose syrup 15 ml at bedtime, and adjust it to two soft motions a day.
items.note: the titration target 'two soft motions a day' is not read as a schedule

items.quote: Take one tablet of the stool softener at night for two weeks.
Warm water and more fibre, and a walk after each meal, will do more than any pill.
items.note: 'after each meal' is not in the schedule grammar, only 'after the meal'/'after food'

items.quote: Do not take the senna or the bisacodyl tablet daily, the bowel gets dependent.
Please note how many motions happen each day, and bring that note to the clinic.
items.note: the extractor only matches 'every N days' or 'daily', so 'each day' yields no schedule

items.quote: If there is blood in the motion or no motion for three days, make sure to call us.

cases.title: Labs before the next visit: what to get, fasting, when to call
lines: Doctor: Before the next visit we need the kidney and sugar numbers, so today I am listing them.
Nurse: Please get the HbA1c and the serum creatinine done in the lab on Tuesday morning.
Doctor: The eye screening and the foot check are due in the follow-up, book the slot for 30/11.
Nurse: Do not eat or drink anything sweet after midnight before the glucose sample.
Doctor: Collect the lab report and bring it to the next appointment, do not post it home.
Nurse: If the sugar runs below seventy or above three hundred, make sure to call us the same evening.

items.quote: Before the next visit we need the kidney and sugar numbers, so today I am listing them.
Please get the HbA1c and the serum creatinine done in the lab on Tuesday morning.
items.note: only the word 'morning' is read, so a one-off test becomes a daily recurrence

items.quote: The eye screening and the foot check are due in the follow-up, book the slot for 30/11.
Do not eat or drink anything sweet after midnight before the glucose sample.
items.note: the fasting window 'after midnight' is not readable, and the sentence lands as a diet rule

items.quote: Collect the lab report and bring it to the next appointment, do not post it home.
If the sugar runs below seventy or above three hundred, make sure to call us the same evening.
items.note: expected: no timing. The word 'evening' inside a call-us-if warning is read as a recurring slot
